name: Thalia (Echoverse)
description: The Echoverse version of Thalia, guardian of the Helvault who is killed for heresy and returns as a protective geist.

description_citations.text: "Thalia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, Thalia finds that Avacyn imprisoned her angelic sisters in the Helvault and her faith shatters.
timeline.quote: when she discovered that Avacyn had imprisoned her angelic sisters inside, her unbreakable faith finally shattered

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn orders Odric to kill Thalia for heresy.
timeline.quote: Avacyn ordered Thalia's longtime comrade Odric to kill her for her heresy.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Guilt-ridden Odric interrs Thalia's relics in a cathedral, where her geist rises to protect them.
timeline.quote: He absconded with her relics and interred them at a cathedral, where her geist arose to protect them.
